title: arenaria ciliata subsp. fugax
intro: Arenaria ciliata subsp. fugax, commonly known as Sea Sandwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sea Sandwort include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential applications in pharmaceutical and cosmetic industries.
